name: Wiki dream
ownerWords: Make the llm-wiki duty keep the wiki in sync and organized by its principles, like a dream pass: a daily job that cleans the wiki, finds the mistakes agents repeat, and fixes the related skills so they stop. The wiki's article list must always be up to date.
goal: The wiki matches the repo and itself. Every curated page is in its hub, every link opens, no curated page links to a session folder or a superseded page, and one topic has one page. Fewer pages break the writing rules each day. A mistake agents make twice in a week becomes a rule in its skill and does not come back. The owner hears only which skill rules changed and what needs his call.

metrics.label: Pages missing date, description or title
Pages older than the code they describe
Pages breaking writing rules, over plan
Repo rules kept only in Prime memory, over plan
Repeated agent mistakes with no skill fix
Fixed mistakes that came back in 7 days
Pages the dream edited twice in 7 days
Inputs the precheck could not read

onMiss: Follow the playbook .agents/skills/apps/llm-wiki/references/wiki-dream.md in auto-sns-agent; read it with `node scripts/skills/read-skill.mjs apps/llm-wiki/references/wiki-dream.md`. The ledger is wiki-dream-ledger.json in this chat's duties folder, ~/.prime/agent/browser-chat/duties/<this chat id>/; read it first and write it last, after your commits. Work from the flagged items. Start one subagent per output item (a hub, a page, a duplicate pair, a skill) and read each result yourself. Caps per day: 10 page subagents and 3 skill subagents. Every commit uses the scope wiki-dream, for example docs(wiki-dream): ...; auto-sns-agent commits go through commit.mjs, sieun-pi commits are plain local commits. Never push either repo. When unsure, leave it and ask the owner. A quiet day (all on target, nothing changed) sends no message.
